## Summary

Elixir Games is an indie game studio. It was founded in 2020 by a team of tooling and gameplay engineers. It builds compact, high-performance gaming experiences and open-source developer prototypes. Its games are board and puzzle games for iOS and Android, and each one has its own page on this site with store links.

Core values stated on the site:
- Player-first design: immediate accessibility and deep, satisfying mechanics.
- Measurable performance: steady frame rates and fast loads, optimized for many devices.
- Open tooling: the studio releases its engines and libraries back to the community.
- Respectful experiences: no attention-hogging loops; the games are about gameplay.

The studio is remote-first and open to contractors and remote hires.

## Games

Each game page includes a description, screenshots and App Store and Google Play links.

### Yatzy
- Page: https://elixirgames.io/yatzy-landing/
- Description: Classic Yatzy on a warm wooden table. Play solo, challenge smart AI, or pass one device around for 1–4 local players.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/yatzy-2-0/id6758081832
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.elixirgames.yatzy

### Mills
- Page: https://elixirgames.io/mills-landing/
- Description: A polished take on Nine Men's Morris with clean presentation, deliberate placement play, and sharp two-player board pressure.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/mills-2-0/id6758081595
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.elixirgames.mills

### Blocks
- Page: https://elixirgames.io/blocks-landing/
- Description: A falling-block puzzle with physics flavor, compact retries, and satisfying recovery when the stack gets messy.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/blocks-2-0/id6760268812
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.elixirgames.blocks

### Paper Soccer
- Page: https://elixirgames.io/paper-soccer-landing/
- Description: Turn-based paper pitch strategy built around bank shots, drawn routes, and clever traps in tight spaces.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/paper-soccer-2-0/id6758081931
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.elixirgames.paper_soccer

### Ships
- Page: https://elixirgames.io/ships-landing/
- Description: A clean battleship-style duel about hidden setups, careful scouting, and landing the right strike at the right time.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/ships-2-0/id6758081929
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.elixirgames.battleships

### Puzzle
- Page: https://elixirgames.io/puzzle-landing/
- Description: A calm, thoughtful shape-fitting puzzler centered on spatial reads, tight placements, and clear board flow.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/puzzle-2-0/id6757918654
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.elixirgames.puzzle

## Careers

Open roles (apply by email to contact@elixirgames.io with the role in the subject line):
- Gameplay Engineer: ship tight, performant gameplay systems; comfortable with low-level optimization.
- Technical Artist: polish visuals while keeping memory and draw calls lean.
- Community Manager (part-time): grow the player base and keep developers and players connected.

Hiring process: Apply, then a short playbook task, then a pair interview, then an offer.

## Support

- Performance: close other browser tabs, enable hardware acceleration in browser settings, or use the native desktop builds where offered.
- Controllers: most games support touch controls and keyboard layouts; controller mapping is listed on each game's page.
- Bugs and refunds: use the contact form at https://elixirgames.io/contact.html or email support@elixirgames.io.
- Community: Discord https://discord.gg/elixir-games and GitHub issues https://github.com/elixir-games.

## Contact

- General and press: contact@elixirgames.io
- Support: support@elixirgames.io
- Privacy requests: privacy@elixirgames.io
- Contact form: https://elixirgames.io/contact.html (replies usually within 3–5 business days)

## Policies

- Privacy Policy: https://elixirgames.io/privacy.html (last updated December 11, 2025). It describes what data the games and this website collect, how it is used and shared, and the rights of users.
